name: contact-us
title: Contact Us
description: A two-column contact block: a sparkle-dusted Contact Us form with name, email and message fields on the left, and a rose gradient card with a slowly turning globe on the right.
use: A product landing page wants an inviting contact form paired with a decorative globe and a strong brand colour.
avoid: A restrained corporate site: the vivid rose card and sparkles dominate the form and fight neutral palettes.
a11y: Fields are labelled and keyboard usable, but the globe and particle loops ignore reduced motion and the sparkles carry no meaning. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide rounded dark container split in two. The left has a bold Contact Us heading with pink italic Us and sparkles, name and email inputs, a tall message box and a rose Send Message button. The right is a rose panel with the line Presenting you with the best UI possible over a dark globe.
behaves: The form and pink card rise and fade in as the section enters view. The globe turns continuously, fields take focus and text, and Send shows a spinner, then Message Sent! with a tick while the fields clear.
customise: Heading, card copy, placeholders and submit behaviour are written into the component; the rose colours, particle count and globe colours are set in the source.
weight: heavy: A continuously spinning globe plus hundreds of particles and a scroll-in animation.
